name: Ruthless

notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +10-50% Chance to deal Double Damage". Name Claude's proposal.

name: Sturdy
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have + 25-50% Extra Health". Never on a map with Mighty (decision 5, group health). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Mighty
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +50-100% Extra Health". Never on a map with Sturdy (decision 5, group health). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Fleet
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +25% Increased Speed" (fixed). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Unyielding
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters cannot be Staggered". Name Claude's proposal.

name: Ironskin
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters are immune to Physical Damage"; decision 5: "immune means takes 95% reduced damage". Physical = blunt, slash, pierce. Never with Warded (group immunity). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Warded
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters are immune to Elemental Damage"; decision 5: 95% reduced. Elemental = fire, frost, lightning, poison (the four Corruption's resistances cover; spirit not included, Claude's reading). Never with Ironskin. Name Claude's proposal.

name: Withering
danger: You lose {value} health per second near the heart.
notes: Krogon's list: "Players have -5 Drain Life per Second" (fixed). Near the heart = within 96 m (decision 8). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Exhausting
danger: You lose {value} stamina per second near the heart.
notes: Krogon's list: "Players have -5 Drain Stamina per Second" (fixed); the game's base stamina regen is also 5 a second (Player.m_staminaRegen = 5f, 1.0.31 code). Within 96 m (decision 8). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Exposed
danger: You have {value}% less resistance to every element near the heart.
notes: Krogon's list: "Players have -25%-50% to All Resistances". Fire, frost, lightning, poison (Corruption's resistances); subtracted from the gear total, below 0 = more damage. Within 96 m (decision 8). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Venomous
danger: Enemy hits add {value}% of their physical damage as poison.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +25-75% of Physical Damage as extra Poison Damage over 5 seconds". The game sets poison's length from the hit's size (SE_Poison), so the copy names no length. Name Claude's proposal.

name: Searing
danger: Enemy hits add {value}% of their physical damage as fire that burns over 5 s.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +25-75% of Physical Damage as extra Fire Damage over 5 seconds". The game's burning lasts 5 s (SE_Burning m_ttl 5). Replaces Smouldering (decision 1). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Stormcalled
danger: Enemy hits add {value}% of their physical damage as lightning.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +25-75% of Physical Damage as extra Lightning Damage". Name Claude's proposal.
